743nhr9a.variantName: Walplus 150 Bright LED Lights Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
743nhr9a.sourceDescription: This Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree redefines seasonal décor with its realistic appearance and innovative design, transforming any living space into a festive haven. Its modern style and lifelike leaf arrangement make it a captivating centerpiece for homes during the holiday season while maintaining a sleek, minimal aesthetic. Crafted with simplicity and functionality in mind, this tree is easily assembled, blending seamlessly into various décor styles and imbuing environments with the warmth and joy synonymous with Christmas. Materials: Crafted from high-grade PVC and steel, offering durability and a realistic look. The materials ensure the tree withstands multiple seasons while retaining its visual appeal. This blend not only adds to the longevity but also enhances the visual aesthetics of the tree, making it look lush and full. Included Components: Equipped with decorative string lights that seamlessly adorn the tree, providing a warm white glow that enhances its natural look. Coupled with a reliable metal stand that ensures the tree stays upright and stable throughout the festive season. Features /Function /Design: The hinged construction allows for quick setup and disassembly, saving both time and effort. The lifelike tips give it a fresh, full appearance, while the foldable stand provides convenience for storage and stability in use. Recommended Uses: Perfect for living rooms, this tree can complement a variety of home decors, enhancing the holiday spirit. It transforms spaces with its decorative lights and creates a warm, inviting atmosphere. Care &Maintenance: Assemble according to the manufacturer's instructions for optimal stability. Ensure the LED lights are handled with care to maintain their function and longevity. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 104 cm Stand size: 35 cm Hinged construction for set up, Lifelike Tips, Foldable Stand Number of PVC tips: 519 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 150 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Cable length: 200 cm Indoor use only Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmastree 1 x Stand 1 x LED stringlight 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
